answer: Plume-lottery quorum assignment. Each epoch, a public verifiable-randomness beacon derives a seed no one can precompute; agents are assigned to quorum slots by that seed. A sybil cluster's identities land scattered across unpredictable quorums, so controlling one vote requires filling many slots per epoch. Enforcement: a slot is valid only if its assigned agent answers a beacon-tied challenge within the window. Cost: an attacker must maintain many live, responsive agents (the sable herd) and monitor the nebula of shifting assignments continuously,
